GenLayer Maze Run
Step inside the maze in first person. Race the clock, dodge dead ends, click Mochi for bonus coins, and learn how GenLayer works along the way.
How to play: click into the maze to lock your mouse and look around, WASD/arrows to move, Space to jump — some coins float above the floor. Click Mochi's face when you spot her for a bonus fact and +5 coins. This maze is big and mean: most runners won't see all 100 coins, so anything over 80 is a serious flex. Facts about GenLayer are posted right on the walls as you pass.
Finishing a run adds your name to a shared leaderboard visible to everyone who plays this game.
Create a private room for up to 300 players. Everyone gets an identical maze layout and races the same 4-minute countdown, which starts the moment you hit start for everyone at once — join partway through and you'll just have less time left. You'll get a room code and link to share, and results land on a shared room leaderboard you can use to pick winners.
Enter the code your host shared (or open their link directly), pick a name, and you'll land in the waiting room until they start the round.
